name: @vektor/latency-harness
description: NW-013: measures the real sensor-to-operator leg of G1's 'sensor-to-decision latency < 60 seconds' — a real AIS event published to Kafka, through a live fusion-svc's EKF/correlation pipeline, to a real Socket.io client receiving the fused Entity. Not a microbenchmark: every hop is the production code path.
